findings.title: Migration crashes when embed_category or uncategorized setting rows are absent
findings.body: The migration does execute(...)[0]['id'] and execute(...)[0]['value'] without checking for an empty result. On a fresh install or any site that never saved embed_category/uncategorized_category_id in site_settings, [0] is nil and nil['id'] raises NoMethodError, aborting the migration and blocking deployment/upgrades.

findings.title: Migration inserts un-normalized hosts via unsanitized raw SQL
findings.body: Legacy embeddable_hosts values such as 'http://discourse.org' or 'https://example.com/1234' are interpolated directly into INSERT without the protocol/path stripping performed by EmbeddableHost.before_validation and without SQL escaping. The stored host therefore will not match EmbeddableHost.record_for_host, which compares lower(host) to the bare URI hostname, so migrated sites silently lose embed access; a value containing a single quote also breaks or injects into the INSERT.

findings.title: before_validation crashes on a nil host instead of returning a validation error
findings.body: self.host.sub! is called unconditionally in before_validation. Creating an EmbeddableHost with a blank/missing host (reachable from Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#create when the admin submits an empty host) raises NoMethodError on nil instead of failing validates_format_of and rendering a JSON error, producing a 500.

findings.title: Update/destroy crash with 500 for a non-existent host id
findings.body: update and destroy use EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first, which returns nil for a stale or invalid id, then call save_host(nil)/nil.destroy. This raises NoMethodError and returns a 500 instead of a 404/not-found response, e.g. when two admins delete/edit the same host concurrently.

findings.title: Edit action crashes when a host has no resolvable category
findings.body: edit() does this.get('host.category.id') without a guard. If the host's category_id points to a deleted category or the category is not present in the client-side category list, host.category is undefined and clicking Edit throws a TypeError, making that host uneditable in the admin UI.

findings.title: Plural embedded hydration inserts undefined entries and discards the ids
findings.body: For *_ids fields, _hydrateEmbedded maps each id through _lookupSubType and unconditionally deletes the original obj[k]. When the referenced collection is not present in the payload root (or a category is not loaded), _lookupSubType returns undefined, so the model gets an array containing undefined instead of the objects/ids, and the source ids are lost. The singular branch preserves the id when hydration fails; the plural branch does not.

findings.title: Category and embeddable_host fabricators were swapped into each other's files
findings.body: category_fabricator.rb now contains only Fabricator(:embeddable_host), while embeddable_host_fabricator.rb contains all the :category/:diff_category/:happy_category/:private_category fabricators. Fabrication loads by scanning files so tests may still pass, but the misplacement makes the fabricators hard to find and risks duplicate-definition or missing-definition errors if either file is later edited, moved, or selectively loaded.
